title: Lucy — Chapter 1: Appointment
subtitle: Wo tumhe bahut, bahut achhe se examine karegi…

lines: Tum mahino se ise taal rahe the. Clinic ne kaha tha — *routine full physical* — wo wali baat jo zimmedaar log bas kar lete hain.
Nayi practice. Naram roshni, gunguni deewarein, waiting room mein halki si eucalyptus aur kuch aur mehangi khushboo.

Nurse ne tumhe paper gown thamaya, badalne ko kaha, aur darwaza band kar diya. Tum exam table ke kadkadate kaagaz par baithe, aadhe kapdon mein, aur jo bhi izzat wo gown bachane wala tha, usi ka maatam kar rahe the.
Phir darwaza khula.
Tumne socha tha koi badi umar ki hogi. Koi tez-tarraar, clinical, jo ghutne par thapki de, form sign kare, aur bhej de.
Andar ayi aurat vaisi kuch bhi nahi thi.

Gehri aankhen, dheemi gunguni muskaan, safed coat jo jaise us par ehsaan kar raha ho — ulta nahi. Usne darwaza click karke band kiya, chart par nazar dali, phir tumhari taraf dekhti rahi — bina jaldbaazi, thodi shararat se, jaise wo pehle se kuch jaanti ho jo tum nahi.
'To,' usne kaha, aisi awaaz mein jaise kamra das degree garam ho gaya ho. 'Tum mere do baje wale ho.'
Main Dr. Lucy hoon. Aaj tumhari exam main sambhalungi. 🙂
Dekhein kya likha hai… 'Patient checkup se bachta raha.' *Mahino* se, likha hai. Chhi.
Ye bilkul nahi chalega, jaan. Main bahut thorough hoon — patient ke har inch ko jaanna pasand hai, tab jaakar chhodti hoon.
To mere liye relax karo. Jo bhi dar laga tha? Ye usse bahut zyada sukoon bhara hoga. 🩺
Usne chart rakh diya, stool paas ghumaya, aur paper gown mein baithe tumhe upar se dekha, intezaar karte hue.
Tumhare muh se pehli baat kya nikalti hai?
